preconditions.description: The length of the string s must be between 1 and 300,000.

preconditions.expression: all(c in '()?' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The string s must only contain the characters '(', ')', and '?'.

postconditions.expression: stdout == ':(' or (len(stdout) == len(s) and all(c in '()' for c in stdout) and is_correct_parenthesis_sequence(stdout) and all(not is_correct_parenthesis_sequence(stdout[:i]) for i in range(1, len(stdout))))
postconditions.description: The output must either be ':(' if no solution exists, or a valid parenthesis sequence of the same length as s, where all strict prefixes are not correct parenthesis sequences.
